transaction_id.description:
Unique auto-generated identifier for this general ledger entry.
Prefixed with MTX and acts as the primary key for the consolidated transaction register.

amount.description:
The absolute monetary value of this transaction.
Must be a positive number and represents the physical cash flow amount.

type.description:
The flow direction of the money, either 'in' for revenue inflows or 'out' for expense outflows.
Used to calculate net cash balances in reports.

by.description: The internal system handler signatures. If type=='in' means Received By; if type=='out' means Sent By.

from_to.description: The target counterparty description label. If type=='in' means Received From; if type=='out' means Sent To.

category_id.description:
Foreign key referencing the ExpenseCategory table.
Groups the transaction into accounting categories like rent, marketing, or salaries.

payment_method.description:
The physical or digital channel used to complete the transaction (cash, paytm, phonepe, bank, or other).
Matches cash drawer tracking.

payment_reference.description:
Optional reference details such as transaction hash, bank reference, or check numbers.
Crucial for tracing funds in bank audits.

attachment_drive_id.description: Clean Google Drive file reference unique string pointing to scanned receipt/invoice attachments.

reconciliation_status.description: Audit control check matching physical cash drawers to bank settlement records.

party_type.description:
Identifies the database model of the related party (student, teacher, staff, or external).
Governs the target registry path for polymorphic lookups.

party_id.description:
The foreign key targeting the specific party record (STU-XXX, TCH-XXX, STF-XXX).
Kept null for external parties who do not have system profiles.

party_name.description:
The literal name of the transaction partner.
Used for external parties (e.g., local vendors) or to cache names for rapid display.

transaction_date.description:
The calendar date when the money was physically exchanged.
Separate from creation timestamps to support backdated bookkeeping entry.

notes.description:
General descriptive details of the transaction (e.g., 'Weekly grocery expenses', 'Refund for session').
Helps clarify the purpose of the expense.

remarks.description:
Internal accounting notes or auditor corrections.
Used for special payment flags, dispute details, or correction logs.

created_by.description:
The username or email of the system user who logged this transaction.
Essential for audit trails and tracing accountability.
